local Library = loadstring(game:HttpGet("https://raw.githubusercontent.com/xHeptc/Kavo-UI-Library/main/source.lua"))()
local Window = Library.CreateLib("script", "DarkTheme")

local Tab = Window:NewTab("Auto")
local Section = Tab:NewSection("Farming")

local autoMoney = false
local autoShard = false

Section:NewToggle("Auto Money", "", function(state)
    autoMoney = state
    while autoMoney do
        task.wait()
        game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage"):WaitForChild("Remotes"):WaitForChild("DigEvent"):FireServer("hello")
    end
end)

Section:NewToggle("Auto Shard", "", function(state)
    autoShard = state
    local rs = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
    local remote = rs:WaitForChild("Remotes"):WaitForChild("TreasureEvent")
    local args = {"Shard"}
    while autoShard do
        remote:FireServer(unpack(args))
        task.wait(0.1)
    end
end)

Section:NewButton("GET OP PET", "", function()
    while true do
        task.wait(0.1)
        game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage"):WaitForChild("Remotes"):WaitForChild("SpinPrizeEvent"):FireServer(4)
    end
end)
